items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Gus, Victor Spencer and I got together a bunch of guys, about eight or nine pieces, and started a band of our own.

ctx.x: But he picked me up pin Baton Rouge, and Victor Spencer, a trumpet player who was playing with the Banner Band -- a left handed trumpet player who was pretty good.
I've heard a lot about him, yeah.
